issuing_body: Children and Families Agency (こども家庭庁)
covered_actors: Local government staff (including child guidance center staff)
Childcare facilities and staff (nursery schools, children's halls)
implementation_notes: Demonstration results report annexed to the Children and Families Agency's Practical Handbook for the Introduction and Utilization of Generative AI, compiled by ABeam Consulting. Summarizes 45 proof-of-concept use cases across 14 Japanese local governments (June 2024 to March 2025) in the child-rearing and childcare sector, detailing operational outcomes, risks, and project-level security practices (such as alignment with Government Common Standards, Digital Agency approval, ISMAP-registered services, opt-out from model training, and domestic region processing for sensitive personal data).
